book.title: BattleTech: BattleMech Manual
book.provenance: User-provided PDF, corrected sixth printing: 326 parsed table-of-contents headings plus 26 manually restored headings from multi-column layout; printed contents pp. 2–3.

scope.disclaimer: Provisional heading-level inventory; many individual rule exceptions are not yet enumerated or tested. No 100% conformity claim.

statusDefinitions.not_audited: Indexed; implementation and tests have not been individually audited.
statusDefinitions.tested_subset: At least one automated test is linked; not necessarily complete.
statusDefinitions.known_missing: Known missing rule/mechanic in current IronHex engine.
statusDefinitions.verified: Entire section independently audited and tested (not assigned by this initial pass).

topics.title: Floating Criticals (Optional)

evidence.test: Floating criticals is opt-in; default location 2 stays in torso (BMM p.45)
Floating critical relocates hit and TAC from initial 2 (BMM p.45)
Floating critical second 2 loses TAC and stays side torso (BMM p.45)
Partial cover rerolls floating critical results for hidden legs (BMM p.45)
Floating criticals does not apply to punch and kick tables

topics.note: Optional BMM p.45 floating criticals implemented in normal hit resolution and exposed as an initiative-locked toggle; all listed scenarios tested, but chapter not yet certified fully verified.

evidence.test: Destroyed torso destroys attached arm and ammunition
Last critical slot hit this phase does not transfer later criticals (BMM p.46)
Ammo explosion bypasses armor and wounds pilot twice
Persistent core damage changes heat and mobility, without hidden client state
Damage to individual critical slots survives serialization and disables weapons

topics.title: Skidding
topics.note: Basic skid PSR, slide damage and involuntary charge on hit are tested. Miss/avoidance continuation and collisions with buildings require further resolution; status stays known_missing.

evidence.test: Skid modifier table matches BMM p.68 at every breakpoint
Failed skid uses prior travel direction and combined fall/slide damage
Successful skid PSR permits entering next hex with no fall
Skid modifiers apply to being targeted and to shots until End Phase
Skid PSR still occurs when leaving pavement onto a clear hex
Skid is triggered by facing changes embedded inside a multi-hex move
Skidding through difficult woods reduces sliding distance as specified in BMM p.68
Skid off the mapsheet destroys the mech rather than leaving invalid coordinates
Skid collision resolves fall first, then involuntary charge and target displacement (BMM p.69)
Unmoved target may avoid an involuntary skidding charge with a PSR
Failed involuntary skidding charge does not displace the target

topics.title: CASE II
topics.note: Inner Sphere CASE II explosion behavior and damage persistence tested. Clan construction/tech-base variant remains missing; no full-section verification.

evidence.test: CASE II torso vents ammo explosion through rear armor, with only one internal hit (BMM p.119)
CASE II limb loses up to half original armor and only one structure point (BMM p.119)
CASE II head loses one structure and half starting head armor (BMM p.119)
CASE II suppresses explosion-generated criticals on secondary roll 8+ (BMM p.119)
CASE II explosion critical takes effect if confirmation roll is below 8
CASE II has inapplicable crit slots and does not prevent ordinary damage transfer
